title: KBC lottery prize with processing fee (Hinglish)
label: scam

lines.text: Badhai ho! Aapka number KBC lucky draw mein select hua hai.
Aapne pachchees lakh rupaye ki lottery jeeti hai.
Prize claim karne ke liye bas pachchees sau rupaye processing fee bharni hogi.
Aaj hi payment kijiye, warna prize cancel ho jayega.
